note: **29, 31 and 33 Lenton Avenue, schedules 184 to 186 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** The far end of the street, where the record held no 1939 round. Irene Doris Horney at 33 is given by the index as Horney (Roe); she is entered under the register name with Roe as the amendment, which wants confirming against the page.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
